title: Cuatro pistas en la calle de los Tilos

scenes.title: Twenty Paces East
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Calle de los Tilos, Clara, Ernesto, and Javier check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: By the Stone Fountain
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, Clara and Javier spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but Ernesto insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: The Famous Shortcut
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, Ernesto leads the group straight back outside Rocio's open café kitchen window at Lemon Tree Inn.

scenes.title: Shadow of the Clock Tower
scenes.summary: Joined by Tomas at the municipal clock tower at noon, Clara and Javier watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Under the Bookshop Arch
scenes.summary: Meeting Carmen under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, Clara spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making Carmen gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: The Shaded Park Bench
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Calle de los Tilos, Javier places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of Lemon Tree Inn with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Opening the Small Envelope
scenes.summary: On the park bench, Clara, Carmen, and Javier break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Message at the Front Desk
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, Clara and Ernesto find Mateo holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
